purpose: Trace the fit-only red/blue audio contrast into the Omni Thinker residual stream
system_prompt: Answer the spoken question with one color word.
hook: post-block Thinker language_model.layers[layer] residual; patch the full-prompt prefill call only, leave one-token decode calls unchanged
audio_position_rule: projected connector rows whose nominal center lies in fixed waveform word slot, mapped through row_map audio_placeholder_token_position
primary_endpoint: complete answer equals donor color with normal EOS
interpretation_limit: Residual states at audio placeholders already mix prior context; a terminal-position swap is a broad positive control, not a word-local mechanism. A final-block audio-position swap should not affect its already-computed terminal state.
